reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.System.Coeffs.σ
Paper notion: the diffusion coefficient sigma: [0,T] x H x P_2(H) -> R^{n x d} of (1.1),
deterministic, entering the forward equation as int_0^t sigma(s,Theta_s,mu_s) dW_s with W
d-dimensional; norms/pairings on it are Frobenius.
What a faithful Lean definition must be: the projection of the coefficient structure onto its
diffusion field, of type (time) -> H -> (measure on H) -> (n x d real matrices, with Frobenius
norm/inner product wherever used, or an equivalent representation such as linear maps
R^d -> R^n with Hilbert-Schmidt norm). Faithful iff Coeffs is faithful and this field has that
type and role.

comparison.text:
Comparison: projection System.Coeffs.σ vs locked reading.
Lean: σ : ℝ → TupleH ν n m d → P2 (TupleH ν n m d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n × Fin d), "the
diffusion σ(t, θ, μ) ∈ ℝ^{n×d}". n × d real matrices as EuclideanSpace on the pairs (i,j), whose
norm/inner product are the Frobenius ones, as the reading required. Time over ℝ; measure type
P2 (H).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Representation choices, harmless: ℝ^{n×d} as EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n × Fin d) (Frobenius norm and
inner product); time over ℝ instead of [0,T] (only [0,T] is used); H the max-norm product (same
topology and P₂); the measure argument the structure P2.
